name: Rimfo Bell Curtis
original_name: リムフォ・ベル・カーチス
source:
Because of Rimfo's avid loyalty to the head maid, she is known around the mansion as "Shefardy's Hound" or "Shefardy's Samurai". As soon as [url=/c105722]Shefardy[/url] becomes interested in [url=/c105716]Mina[/url], Rimfo is the first one to get involved with Mina.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
